why: Women's shoes, boots and sneakers, with handbags, accessories and some clothing and denim, sold through its own stores, its website and department stores.
origin: Founded in New York, United States in 1990 by Steve Madden.

quote.q: I get my inspiration from pounding the pavement all over the world.

opview: “I get my inspiration from pounding the pavement all over the world.” — Steve Madden, founder, About Steve Madden, stevemadden.com

facts_read.source: brand site (About, Fall campaign); SEC 10-K FY2025 (filed 2026-03-02); Vinted catalogue page; TRR designer index; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Steve Madden women's shoes and women's clothing (Shopify product_type "Women's Shoes" / "Women's Clothing"); men's, kids', handbags excluded; Madden Girl not on this site

doors.note: Locator says "ALL STEVE MADDEN STORE LOCATIONS (117)", but the 117 entries mix 86 store pages with 24 city/region hub entries (e.g. "Los Angeles", "Illinois") and 7 entries whose store page is missing (Cabazon, Gilroy, Gilroy Premium, Houston — 404; Desert Hills Premium Outlets, Ft Worth TX, King of Prussia Mall — link to the locator root). Hub pages were crawled; they add no store beyond the 86. So 86 US doors read = 43 full-price + 43 outlet; the 7 dead entries are NC (likely doors exist — Desert Hills, Gilroy, KOP, Fort Worth — but no address on the brand's site). The locator gives no store type: 27 outlets by name, 16 by outlet-centre venue. Men's and women's carried in the same stores.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 303 distinct styles in All Clothing (411 products, all typed Women's Clothing; colour stripped from the title), grouped by the menu c
